visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with a short beard and a black head wrap, wearing a traditional black Japanese kendo or samurai outfit, is kneeling on a small, patterned rug indoors in front of floor-to-ceiling white cabinets. He holds a long black object resembling a katana hilt, which is resting in a black stand decorated with intricate blue and yellow woven patterns. He maintains a serious, stoic expression. (2) A second man, wearing a casual grey shirt and loose grey trousers, enters the frame from the left and stops before the kneeling man. He removes his black loafers and sets them on the tiled floor. The man in black watches him closely. (3) The man in black draws the object from the stand with a swift, stylized motion, revealing it to be a long, metallic shoehorn with a katana-style handle. He extends the chrome shoehorn toward the floor. A close-up shot captures the shoehorn sliding into the heel of a black shoe as the man in grey slips his foot back in without bending down. (4) Detailed close-up shots highlight the blue and yellow "odoshi" weaving on the base of the shoehorn stand. The man in black then demonstrates the product's 70cm length and 500g weight by performing a series of dynamic samurai sword poses and strikes in the room, emphasizing the ergonomic handle and realistic feel. (5) The scene shifts to a screen recording of the Buyee digital interface, showing the "Koikiya Tokyo" store page with the katana shoehorn and other traditional crafts. Text in Traditional Chinese and Japanese is visible on the screen. (6) Back in the interior setting, the man in black holds a 1,000 Yen note and smiles. He demonstrates using the shoehorn while standing up to put on a red and white Nike sneaker, showing its practicality for modern footwear. He concludes by bowing respectfully.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a male narrator speaking Mandarin in a deep, authoritative tone, assuming a dramatic persona. He is accompanied by traditional Japanese-style background music featuring plucked strings and high-pitched flute melodies over a steady, cinematic beat. The mix is clear with studio-grade fidelity. (2) A sharp, metallic "whoosh" sound effect punctuates the track as the katana is drawn. The narrator's speech rate remains steady while the music maintains a minor-key epic tonality. There is no ambient noise, and the signal-to-noise ratio is pristine. (3) The narrator transitions into a conversational, informative tone to describe the product's technical specifications. High-frequency digital "click" and "pop" sound effects are heard periodically during screen transitions. The background music evolves into a more modern, upbeat hybrid style with electronic percussion underpinnings. (4) In the final phase, the narrator concludes his pitch and speaks a closing phrase in Japanese with a warm, rising intonation. The music reaches its peak volume before fading out alongside the final speech tokens, accompanied by a soft closing chime sound effect.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Hook -> Demonstration -> Technical Details -> Shopping Guide -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To promote a specialized Japanese-made shoehorn designed like a katana from Koikiya Tokyo. The video uses a humorous martial arts skit to capture interest before detailing the product's craftsmanship and providing a specific purchasing path through the Buyee platform with a discount offer.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct display of product features, brand name (Koikiya Tokyo), shopping platform (Buyee), and a specific member discount for registration.
